strategy.name: Heikin Ashi + SuperTrend Decision-Tree Strategy
strategy.description: Trend-following decision tree. SuperTrend sets direction and the trigger (its flip), Heikin Ashi confirms momentum, and an EMA200 filter keeps trades on the right side of the higher-timeframe trend. Every bar resolves to exactly one action: long, short, hold, or wait. Full plan and backtest in docs/heiken-ashi-supertrend-plan.md.

indicators.supertrend: Direction + trigger. ATR(10) x 3.0 bands. Green line under price = uptrend, red line over price = downtrend. A flip of the line is the entry trigger.
indicators.heikin_ashi: Momentum confirmation. Smoothed candles from OHLC. Green (haClose > haOpen) confirms buyers; red confirms sellers. A small opposing wick means a strong, one-sided candle.
indicators.ema_200: Trend filter / bias gate. Longs only when price is above EMA(200); shorts only when below. Removing this filter roughly halves profit factor in backtest.

long: SuperTrend has just flipped bullish on this candle
Price is above EMA(200) — aligned with the higher-timeframe trend
short: SuperTrend has just flipped bearish on this candle
Price is below EMA(200) — aligned with the higher-timeframe trend

exit_rules: Exit long when SuperTrend flips bearish; exit short when SuperTrend flips bullish (primary exit — lets winners run the whole trend leg)
Hard stop: 2 x ATR(10) from entry (below entry for longs, above for shorts) — the disaster brake
One position at a time — no pyramiding, no averaging down
risk_rules: Risk maximum 1% of portfolio per trade — distance to the ATR stop sets the position size
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Never override the stop — the decision tree exits you, you do not hold and hope
Paper trade on your specific asset and timeframe before going live
notes: Trend-following, not scalping — best on 1H/4H/1D where trend legs are clean. Expect a low win rate (~33% in the daily BTC backtest) with a profit factor above 1.5: most trades are small losses and a few ride an entire trend for the gains. Do not try to raise the win rate; it cuts the winners. Optional strong-candle gate (opposing HA wick <= 30% of body) trades less often for a similar edge. The EMA200 filter is essential — keep it on. For 1m-5m scalping, drop the EMA to 50 and the ATR multiplier toward 2.0, and validate on paper first.
